chapter.heading: God the Help of Those Who Seek HimA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
I will
lift up my eyes to the hills—From whence comes my help?

My help
comes from the Lord,Who made heaven and earth. [Jer. 17:19; 26:2]

He will
not allow your foot to be moved;He who keeps you will not slumber. [Jer. 4:1; 18:11;]

Behold, He
who keeps IsraelShall neither slumber nor sleep. [Jer. 7:8; Mic.]

The Lord
is your keeper;The Lord is your shade at your right hand. [1 Kin. 6:12; Jer. 21:12; 22:3]

The sun
shall not strike you by day,Nor the moon by night. [Deut. 6:14, 15; Jer. 13:10]

The Lord
shall preserve you from all evil;He shall preserve your soul. [Deut. 4:40 g Jer.]

The Lord
shall preserve your going out and your coming inFrom this time forth, and even forevermore. [Jer. 5:31;]
